# Zephyre Systems

> Preparing to launch independent IT support for home users and small businesses in the Minneapolis-Saint Paul, Minnesota area.

Zephyre Systems is not yet accepting new support requests. The service catalog and pricing are public previews while launch preparations are completed.

This file lists the public Zephyre Systems pages intended for search engines and real-time AI assistants. Customer tickets, administrative interfaces, private infrastructure, and authenticated services are not public resources.

## Company and support information

- [Zephyre Systems homepage](https://zephyresystems.com/): Services, pricing, service area, contact information, and support process.
- [Support requests](https://zephyresystems.com/support): Pre-launch notice. The request form and support email action are currently disabled.
- [Public status directory](https://zephyresystems.com/status): Human-readable links to Zephyre's published status pages.

## Live public status

- [Consolidated current status (JSON)](https://zephyresystems.com/status.json): Current state and 24-hour uptime for monitors already published on the three public Uptime Kuma pages.
- [Consolidated current status (Markdown)](https://zephyresystems.com/status.md): The same current public status in concise text for assistants.
- [Zephyre Systems Status](https://status.zephyresystems.com/status/zephyre-systems): Public website and support-portal availability.
- [Zephyre Infrastructure Status](https://monitor.zephyresystems.com/status/dashboard): Public infrastructure-health dashboard.
- [Lush & Lust Production Status](https://prodstatus.zephyresystems.com/status/production-status): Public production-service health.

## Usage preferences

Public pages may be indexed and used as real-time input for answers with attribution. They may not be used for model training. See [robots.txt](https://zephyresystems.com/robots.txt) for the machine-readable policy.
